events.did: Found that Xavi's phone had been dead and his message undeliverable
events.quote_anchor: A small red x had shown up beside the message, saying it could not be delivered.

events.did: Saw the news that local man Charles Fontaine was found dead of a suspected aneurysm
events.quote_anchor: Local man Charles Fontaine found dead of a suspected aneurysm.

events.did: Opened a filtered list of other prospective chemists on his laptop while drinking scotch
events.quote_anchor: A list of other prospective chemists sat open on his laptop, filtered by location, background, specialty, access to ingredients.

events.did: Sat down before his inhaler and his gun waiting on the coffee table
events.quote_anchor: In front of him, two objects sat waiting on the coffee table.

events.did: Laid a hand on top of the inhaler to stop Victor from using it
events.quote_anchor: Victor reached for the inhaler. Or, was about to, when Eli laid a hand on top of it.

events.did: Lunged for the inhaler and found the vial empty because he had not swapped it out
events.quote_anchor: But when he brought it to his lips, nothing came out. The vial. He hadn’t swapped the vial out.

events.did: Got the last new vial into the inhaler, forced it to his mouth and breathed in as the compound cut the pain
events.quote_anchor: With the last seconds of strength, he forced the inhaler to his mouth, and hit the button, and breathed in.

events.did: Paused on the third chemist profile, Prof. Daniela Dean of Lockland University
events.quote_anchor: Victor clicked through the profiles, pausing on the third.

relations.did: Was Victor's best friend and his mortal enemy, and now appeared only as a ghost in Victor's head
relations.quote_anchor: Not when he was his best friend. Not when he was his mortal enemy. And not now, when he was a ghost.

relations.did: Her suspicions after Victor's arrest led to his years of solitary confinement
relations.quote_anchor: Thanks to Stell’s suspicions after his arrest, he’d endured five years of solitary confinement and constant scrutiny

relations.did: Could not protect Sydney or Mitch in his diminished state and called himself prey
relations.quote_anchor: Could not protect Sydney or Mitch. He was not a predator. He was prey.

relations.did: Had carved the words he was telling himself out of his parents' self-help book
relations.quote_anchor: They were his. Carved from a block of text in one of his parents’ self-help books.

numbers.did: Had been dead for more than a week
numbers.quote_anchor: Xavi’s phone was dead, had been for more than a week—Victor knew because that was when he’d first messaged

numbers.did: Was back where he had started nine months ago
numbers.quote_anchor: which meant Victor was back where he’d started nine months ago. Caught in the same forsaken loop.

numbers.did: Endured five years of solitary confinement and five more in the prison block at Wrighton
numbers.quote_anchor: he’d endured five years of solitary confinement and constant scrutiny, five more within the prison block at Wrighton.

numbers.did: Had been driven by another force after his second resurrection
numbers.quote_anchor: And then, after his second resurrection, Victor had been driven by another force.

numbers.did: Wore off somewhere between the first glass and second glass of whisky
numbers.quote_anchor: Somewhere between the first glass and second glass of whisky, the compound had worn off, and now his nerves were humming

numbers.did: Was the third profile Victor paused on
numbers.quote_anchor: He sank into the chair before the laptop and drew up the list of prospective chemists he and Mitch had compiled.
